partner_result.applied_equation: For each fixed hub value h, ||p_(2cUV+beta(h)U+gamma(h)V+delta(h))||_r <= 2^alpha |c|^-alpha. This supplies the M_r input to the hub-conditional vector-valued frequency theorem.

new_results.statement: For a critical two-hub packet with arbitrary same-bank phase R(Y), a residual Z(H,W) may depend arbitrarily on both hubs provided esssup_h ||p_(Z(h,W))||_r <= M_r. Then ||p_Q||_infty <= K_r (P M_r)^[r/(2r-1)] and p_Q is continuous C0.

For Q=H^TCH+2H^T(BY+d+aU+bV)+R(Y)+2cUV+beta U+gamma V+delta, both U,V may shift the hubs and R(Y) may be arbitrary measurable; ||p_Q||_infty <= C_r det(BB^T)^[-r/(4(2r-1))]|c|^[-(r-1)/(2r-1)]. At r=2 the bound is 3 det(BB^T)^(-1/6)|c|^(-1/3).
The same compiler holds when the residual depends arbitrarily on the slope bank Y, provided the conditional residual L^r norm is uniformly bounded and the residual source W is source-disjoint.

preserved_counterexample: For any fixed nonzero quadratic frequency s, a cap-one density supported on finitely many phase-aligned fragments can make Re E exp(isX^2) arbitrarily close to one; no law-uniform positive-power pointwise decay is used.
unresolved_implication: QFORM-TWO-HUB-HYPERBOLIC-PAIR-BOTH-SIDES-ENTANGLED-v1: pay simultaneous H- and Y-dependent affine coefficients of the same hyperbolic pair, likely by a rank-three physical cross-block exit plus a near-rank-two algebraic reduction.
